parameters.name: IstioGatewayName
parameters.description: The name of the ASM gateway.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of Istio gateways to query.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace in which the ASM gateway resides.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh describe-istio-gateway-domains --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --istio-gateway-name ingressgateway --namespace default --limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh DescribeIstioGatewayDomains --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --Limit 10 --Namespace default --IstioGatewayName ingressgateway
